text:
lina_sales: Heads-up: NimbusPay POC demo flaked during warmup  clients saw "429 Too Many Requests" in console. Demo in ~30m.

omar_se: Which tenant and sample id? Any rate-limit headers?

lina_sales: tenant=nimbuspay-poc, sample req=req_np_f1a. Header: X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 Retry-After:4. They spun up ~40 parallel browser sessions during smoke.

chris_oncall: Paging oncall. I can open a short burst for the tenant if eng approves. Patch would be `POST /internal/admin/tenants/nimbuspay-poc/burst {"minutes":25,"qps":300}`. Ops ticket OPS-1287.

tess_engineer: Approve temporary burst. Also recommend we switch their demo routing to region-us-west to avoid noisy neighbors. Sending client snippet: max concurrency=6, exponential backoff + jitter.

scale_bot: [autoscaler] cluster-omega free_nodes=1 avg-latency=98ms last_deploy=stable@2026-12-03T08:12Z

chris_oncall: Burst applied for 25m. Watching ingress for req_np_f1a.

omar_se: Tail of ingress logs shows token bucket exhaustion then success after burst was applied:
```
[INGRESS] 2026-12-03T08:21:10Z tenant=nimbuspay-poc req=req_np_f1a route=/v1/checkout status=429 reason=bucket_empty concurrent=42
[INGRESS] 2026-12-03T08:21:11Z tenant=nimbuspay-poc req=req_np_f1a route=/v1/checkout status=200 lat_ms=145
```

lina_sales: Demo resumed and went well. Customer asked about SLA for peak shopping hours and enterprise pricing for spike protection.

pat_security: Also flagged: they want confirmation that card PANs are tokenized client-side. Please open a separate security thread with flow diagram and questionnaire. I'll attach SOC2 and PCI scoping checklist.

tess_engineer: Follow-ups for eng: (1) add a one-click demo-burst flow in Console with audit logging, (2) publish the client backoff snippet in sales playbook, (3) prepare Dedicated sizing options and a spike-protection add-on.

chris_oncall: Burst will auto-revoke at T+25m. OPS-1287 remains open for quota review.

lina_sales: Thanks all, scheduling a post-demo call to discuss reserved QPS and a 2-week Dedicated trial. Will start the security thread now. :thumbsup:
